title: 「The same is true of ／ The same applies to X」表達「……也是如此」
titleZh: 「The same is true of ／ The same applies to X」表達「……也是如此」
titleEn: Using “The same is true of / The same applies to X”

source.file: Sentence Structure 256 -「The same is true of _ The same applies to X」表達「……也是如此」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than the system lesson because two distinct source PDFs are labelled 201; source number N therefore maps to system ID ssN+1.

formula: Previous statement. + The same + be + true of + X.

formulas.formula: Previous statement. + The same + be + true of + X.
Previous rule or principle. + The same + apply to + X.
The same + noun + applies / apply to X.
The same was true of X.
The same will be true of X.
The same will apply to X.
The same is not true of X.
The same does not apply to X.
Is the same true of X? / Does the same apply to X?

example: Online learning requires self-discipline. The same is true of working from home.
exampleZh: 網上學習需要自律。在家工作也是如此。

examples.en: Online learning requires self-discipline. The same is true of working from home.
examples.zh: 網上學習需要自律。在家工作也是如此。
examples.highlight: The same is true of working from home.

examples.en: Exercise benefits the body. The same is true of the mind.
examples.zh: 運動對身體有益，對心靈也是如此。
examples.highlight: The same is true of the mind.

examples.en: All employees must protect customer information. The same applies to temporary staff.
examples.zh: 所有僱員都必須保護顧客資料。臨時職員也須遵守同一規定。
examples.highlight: The same applies to temporary staff.

examples.en: The same principle applies to small businesses.
examples.zh: 同一原則也適用於小型企業.
examples.highlight: The same principle applies to small businesses.

meaning.zh: 這兩個表達都能避免重複整個陳述。The same is true of X 通常把前述事實、描述、經歷、情況或趨勢延伸至 X；The same applies to X 通常把前述規則、原則、要求、條件或建議延伸至 X。

rules.zh: the same 必須指向前文已提到或語境中清楚的意思；沒有清楚前文時，讀者可能不知道「相同」的是甚麼。
rules.en: The same must refer to information that has already been stated or is clear from the context. Without that context, the reader may not know what is also true or applicable.
examples: Large companies need accurate records. The same is true of small businesses.

rules.zh: 表示「……也是如此」時使用 true of，而不是 true to。true to 表示忠於某人、承諾或原則，意思不同。
rules.en: Use true of, not true to, for the target meaning. True to has a different meaning, such as remaining loyal to a person, promise or principle.
examples: The same is true of younger workers.
She remained true to her principles.

rules.zh: 使用 apply to，而不是 apply of。
rules.en: Use apply to, not apply of.
examples: The same rule applies to online orders.
Incorrect: The same rule applies of online orders.

rules.zh: 在本句型中，apply 表示規則、原則或要求「適用於」某情況；它不是申請工作、塗上油漆或施加壓力的意思。
rules.en: In this structure, apply means to be relevant, valid or effective in a particular case. It does not mean apply for a job, apply paint to a wall or apply pressure.

rules.zh: 應按前文意思選擇表達：事實、描述、特點、經歷、情況、趨勢、結果或觀察通常用 The same is true of X；規則、原則、要求、指示、限制、程序、條件、期限或建議通常用 The same applies to X。
rules.en: Choose the expression according to the preceding idea. Prefer The same is true of X after a fact, description, quality, experience, situation, tendency, result or observation; prefer The same applies to X after a rule, principle, requirement, instruction, restriction, procedure, condition, deadline or piece of advice.

rules.zh: 改寫時必須保留時態和情態：過去事實使用 was true，過去規則使用 applied；未來使用 will be true 或 will apply；可能或不確定情況須保留適當情態動詞。
rules.en: Preserve tense and modality. Past facts require was true; past rules require applied. Future situations require will be true or will apply, and possible or uncertain situations require a suitable modal verb.

rules.zh: 本課目標是較簡潔的 The same is true of X，通常不需要加入 thing。The same thing is true of X 雖然合乎文法，但不是本練習採用的目標形式。
rules.en: Use the concise target The same is true of X. The longer form The same thing is true of X is grammatical, but it is not the form used in this exercise.

benefits.zh: 當同一意思也涉及另一個人、群體或情況時，可以避免把整個陳述重複一次。
benefits.en: It prevents unnecessary repetition: you can avoid repeating an entire statement when it also concerns another person, group or situation.

benefits.zh: 讀者可以立即看出新例子與上文具有相同的事實、規則或原則，清楚理解兩者的關係。
benefits.en: It shows exactly how a new example connects to the previous one: the reader immediately understands that the second example shares the same fact, rule or principle.

benefits.zh: 你可以把下一個例子直接連接到上文，不必另起一段重新解釋，使說明更流暢和容易理解。
benefits.en: It helps you move smoothly from one example to another instead of starting a separate explanation.

benefits.zh: 小心選擇兩個句型，可以清楚顯示你是在描述相同情況，還是把同一規則延伸至另一個對象。
benefits.en: It helps distinguish facts from rules by showing whether you are describing a shared situation or extending a rule.

benefits.zh: 你可以比較不同群體，而不用重複列出相同特點或要求，使比較更簡潔。
benefits.en: It makes comparisons more concise because you can compare groups without repeating the same quality or requirement.

benefits.zh: 否定和疑問形式可以檢視概括說法是否真的延伸至另一情況，適合討論例外和不確定性，並避免過度概括。
benefits.en: It helps you discuss exceptions and uncertainty by testing whether a general statement really extends to another case, preventing overgeneralisation.
